title: A customer stored with unknown term text shows that text in Edit Customer
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop has an older customer whose credit term text, such as Prepaid, is not a term ShopView knows.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} is stored with a credit term text ShopView does not know, {Text-A} (from an old import).
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-22 Customer and {Text-A} is Prepaid.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open Edit Customer for {Customer-A}.
  2. Open the Credit Terms dropdown.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: Credit Terms shows {Text-A} selected, without "(Inactive)".
  • Step 2: {Text-A} is listed after the active terms.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-E2: “A customer whose stored term is text ShopView does not know (from an old import) shows that text selected in Edit Customer, after the active terms, without "(Inactive)".”
